title: Stunning 4BR Pet-Friendly 30A Home with a Private Pool
meta_description: Stay at Blue Pineapple, a pet-friendly 4BR, 3BA vacation home on 30A with a private saltwater pool, tropical landscaping, and Xplorie benefits. Sleeps 11.
description_expanded: Blue Pineapple is a stunning 4-bedroom beach retreat nestled in the serene Seagrove community, Village of Sugar Sands. Step into a backyard oasis featuring a brand-new heated saltwater pool, lush tropical landscaping, and soft turf, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. As you arrive, simply turn left at the front steps and follow the charming porch, where six beach chairs await, ready for your beach adventures. With just a two-minute walk to the shoreline and space to comfortably sleep 11 guests, this home promises the perfect getaway for families and friends.You'll feel welcomed immediately when you walk into this cool blue home. Clean white finishes with pops of coastal blues are everywhere you turn. Unique designer touches make this home even more special. Blue Pineapple boasts 2 king master suites, one conveniently on the 1st floor and the other upstairs with the other 2 bedrooms.Sleeping Arrangements - Sleeps 11:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King bed, TV, desk and patio access. Private bathroom.2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, TV and balcony access. Private bathroom.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: 2 full beds, TV2nd Floor, Bedroom 4: Twin-over-full bunk bed, TV.To make your stay even better, you’ll have complimentary use of a golf cart and six bikes, so exploring 30A is a breeze. Whether you’re cruising to the beach, checking out nearby shops, or simply soaking in the coastal charm, having these amenities so close to the beach makes your getaway that much more enjoyable.Beach Access:Head west on Sugar Sand Lane and turn left on Somerset Bridge. Directly across 30A at the Tom Thumb is your beach access.Distance: .1 mile | Time: 3 minutes walkingVillage of Sugar Beach:Village of Sugar Beach is in the heart of Seagrove and just short walk across 30A to the sugar sand beaches. This community has no thru streets so there is minimal traffic making it safe for the kids. There is a community pool for the entire family to enjoy. Local shops and favorite restaurants are within walking distance. Minutes away is Deer Lake State Park, offering miles of biking trails. Seaside is only a 1 ½ miles away where you can enjoy events throughout the year.Seagrove Beach:Named for the thick grove of oak trees lining its coastline, Seagrove Beach is located in the heart of 30A. There's no better spot to experience everything 30A has to offer! Feeling adventurous? Rent a bike and jump on the 20-mile Timpoochee bike trail that runs right around the corner from the neighborhood. Visit famous Seaside and Grayton Beach State Park to the West. Head East and discover more of Seagrove Beach plus the wonderful coastal communities of Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Enjoy exploring the boutique shops, fabulous restaurants, and beautiful state parks in each of these communities.Your stay at Blue Pineapple comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pool heat can be added for an additional fee* Parking for 4 cars.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
